parameters: You did it...\| you damn well bloody did it.
Barnabas...\| how can you still see me like that...\| this victory has cost far too much.
You are planning on delving into the cult's little hideaway, no?\! It is a risky affair...
We have no choice now. I've pulled you all into hell.

Oh, come now, this was all inevitable. Focus, darling!\! Their leader will always be several steps ahead... always looking at how to exploit every tiny weakness.\! He will come at you from every angle...\| every possible way to cause harm.\!  Just stick with me, alright darling?\! Don't trust what you see in there...\| question everything.
